rules.summary: Single 9-team division, double round robin (72 fixtures, 16 per team). Standings = order of points: 3 per win, 1 per tie, 0 per loss. Equal points at the top = co-champions. No regular-season overtime (ties stand). Tiebreakers: (1) head-to-head winning pct, (2) record above the tie (winning pct), (3) spring draw numbers (lowest wins). Multi-team ties: seed one team then restart among the rest. Last playoff spot (6th): play-in game unless one team swept the head-to-head 2-0.
rules.drawNumbersSource: https://www.mcalsports.org/Schedules/Fall/FieldHockey_26.pdf (legend: AW1 R2 T3 B4 LW5 U6 MC7 CVS/CSH8 MA9)
rules.maxprepsPlacementWarning: MaxPreps conferenceStandingPlacement ranks by conference winning pct (ties = half) and MUST NOT be used; MaxPreps conferencePoints is goals-for, not standings points. On 2026-10-02 MaxPreps had University 1st, MCAL points put Tamalpais 1st (31 vs 23).

postseason.qualifiersConflict: Handbook §8b (rev 10/19/24) says top 4; 2026 playoff sheet (adopted June 2024) says 6. Use 6 [U which governs].
postseason.seeding: by league standing (points, then MCAL tiebreakers)
postseason.seedingNote: Points (3-1-0), not winning pct: handbook 7a 'MCAL placement will be the order of team points', 8b 'as determined by the point total'. Confirmed by 2025 (Redwood 40 pts seeded #1 over Tamalpais 39 despite equal win pct and Tam's 2-0 head-to-head).
postseason.qualifiersEvidence2025: The 2025 tournament had 6 qualifiers (QFs 5 at 4, 6 at 3 on 2025-10-28; byes for Redwood and Tamalpais), so the 6-team sheet, not handbook 8b 'top 4', was in force in 2025 too.

rounds.note: Only if tied for 6th without a 2-0 head-to-head sweep; host = highest draw number. Sheet says "Saturday October 23" but 2026-10-23 is a Friday; schedule grid shows Fri 23.

games: best remaining seed among 3-6 (smallest number) at 2
rounds.rule: Re-seeded after the quarterfinals: the two QF winners (seeds 3-6) are sorted by seed; the larger seed number travels to #1, the smaller to #2. The sheet's wording "(lowest seed (3-6) left in the tournament) at (1st)" means lowest-RANKED, not seed #3.

evidence2025.seeds: 1 Redwood 40 pts (13-2-1), 2 Tamalpais 39 (12-1-3), 3 Marin Catholic 34 (10-2-4), 4 Lick-Wilmerding 33 (10-3-3), 5 University 26 (8-6-2), 6 Convent of the Sacred Heart 14 (4-10-2); regular season = MaxPreps 25-26 conference record minus the contestType-0 SF/final games, cross-checked game-by-game for TM RW MC LW UN

evidence2025.semifinals: 2025-10-29: (5) University 1 at (1) Redwood 4 (a3aee4a1-4aaf-4752-b62d-b4f72b14ab8d, location 'MCAL Semi Finals'); (3) Marin Catholic 0 at (2) Tamalpais 1 (cb5f9d81-77f3-4d39-ac92-2ecbf7de925c)
evidence2025.final: 2025-10-31 at Tamalpais although Redwood was the #1 seed (3fb94e4a-b4f6-45d3-b205-5ad86e68a07b)
evidence2025.whyUnambiguous: Seeding is by points (handbook 7a/8b), so Redwood (40) is #1 over Tamalpais (39) even though both are 13.5/16 on winning pct and Tam won the head-to-head 2-0. Under 'smallest number at #1', Marin Catholic would have gone to Redwood.

rounds.siteNote: Fixed site, not 'higher seed hosts': the 2025 final (#1 Redwood vs #2 Tamalpais) was played at Tamalpais.

postseason.titles: Regular-season points leader = MCAL Champion (co-champions on equal points); a different playoff winner also receives a pennant (General Rules "Pennants").
